prompt: Generate a weekly report for this week's commits and TODO changes, save it as a markdown file

assertions.name: report-file-exists
assertions.description: 报告文件存在于 reports/ 目录下

assertions.name: correct-filename-format
assertions.description: 文件名符合 weekly-report-YYYY-MM-DD.md 格式

assertions.name: has-overview-or-summary
assertions.description: 报告包含概览/统计类章节

assertions.name: has-commit-info
assertions.description: 报告包含提交相关信息

assertions.name: has-todo-section
assertions.description: 报告包含 TODO 变更章节

assertions.name: references-branch-name
assertions.description: 报告中包含当前分支名

assertions.name: contains-date-range
assertions.description: 报告包含本周日期范围
